jobs.description:
Job Description

At Netcompany, we are looking for recent graduates with a bachelor’s degree who want a challenging, social and developing start to their career as an Associate Consultant. Are you excited by the opportunity to work on complex IT solutions that make a real impact, while combining hands-on development with project delivery and close client interaction?

The Associate Consultant role exists across both Consulting and Application Services. The main difference lies in how you work with clients and solutions, and which setup fits your interests best. Either a more project-oriented environment (Consulting) or a more long-term, team- and solution-driven setup (Application Services).

Responsibilities & technologies

As an Associate Consultant at Netcompany, you will contribute to translating customer needs into the right technical solutions. Depending on the project and customer, you may become part of either our Application Services or Consulting business area. In both areas, you will work closely with exciting customers and colleagues to develop and deliver high-quality IT solutions. Your work will span different projects, technologies, and domains, giving you the opportunity to continuously expand your knowledge and expertise. We work with a wide range of technologies and platforms, such as .NET, C#, Java, React, Angular, Salesforce, Microsoft, Oracle, Adobe and more.

As an Associate Consultant, you will contribute to all aspects of system development with focus on technical tasks. Your tasks and responsibilities will vary from project to project and evolve over time, but your responsibilities will typically include:

• Customer dialogue and requirements clarification.

• Development of frontend and backend features for customer solutions.

• Setup and development of frameworks, integrations, and extensions for standard platforms.

• Automation of business processes through, for example, batch jobs.

• Development of tools and scripts for data migration and other technical solutions.

About you

We expect you to hold a bachelor's degree or diploma in engineering, computer science, software, IT, or a similar field. To succeed in this role, you:

• Are newly graduated or have a couple of years of experience. Most importantly, you are passionate about taking your IT career to the next level.

• Possess strong IT technical skills within object-oriented programming.

• Have fundamental knowledge of software development and are motivated to develop your competencies.

• Think analytically, show initiative, and work in a structured way.

• Full professional proficiency in Danish and English (written and spoken) is a must.

Continue developing with us

At Netcompany, we focus on your personal and professional development.

When you join us, you will be assigned a personal mentor who will guide you through your development and help you achieve your goals. The close relationship with an experienced colleague helps ensure the well-being of each employee and provides you with concrete insights into the many different career opportunities as you build your experience.

Additionally, you will be enrolled in our internal training programme, Netcompany Academy, where you are offered courses and seminars on everything from technologies to customer management. All courses are taught by experienced Netcompany colleagues, ensuring that all content is highly relevant and builds upon your professional skills, preparing you for various tasks and continuously improving your expertise throughout your career with us.

Join an inclusive community

At Netcompany, we highly prioritise an inclusive community. We actively promote an open and welcoming work culture based on collaboration and mutual trust, where there is always an opportunity for sparring.

As part of our culture and values, all employees, regardless of background, identity, and experience, are met with understanding and respect and given equal opportunities for development and well-being.

As we are an international company with offices in many countries, you will have the opportunity to learn and collaborate internationally with colleagues from across the world. We offer a shared environment where we engage with each other across departments and projects. Additionally, we have a wide range of social and professional events that provide you with the best opportunities to expand and build a network early in your career.

Send us your application

Upload your resume and a motivational letter to our recruitment system via the link. If you have unanswered questions, feel free to write to hr.dk@netcompany.com.

All qualified candidates are encouraged to apply regardless of gender, gender expression, sexuality, disability, age, religion and belief, political views, nationality, ethnicity, or social background.

We are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse environment. Our recruitment processes are based on individual merit. If you require any reasonable adjustments or additional support during the interview process, please email our recruiters at reasonableadjustments@netcompany.com for assistance. #LI-SA1

At MFT Energy, we innovate energy trading through our people and technology.

Are you curious about how risk is managed in one of the fastest-moving industries in the world? At MFT Energy, we are looking for a Student Risk Analyst who wants to gain hands-on experience working with data and risk management in a dynamic energy trading environment.

The role as a Student Risk Analyst:

You will join our Finance, Risk & Treasury department, where you will be part of our Risk team working alongside experienced colleagues with deep industry expertise. The team works closely with stakeholders across the trading organization to provide transparency on the company’s overall risk profile and support informed decision-making.

In a business characterized by rapidly changing market conditions and significant volatility, the Risk team helps ensure a responsible balance between risk and return across all our trading activities.

In this role, you will work with a wide range of datasets, including trade data and market price data that form the foundation of our risk calculations. Through this work, you will contribute to maintaining reliable risk data and develop a strong understanding of how risk management supports a modern energy trading company.

The position offers a steep learning curve in a fast-paced environment where no two days are the same.

Your key responsibilities:

• Working with large trade and market price datasets to ensure the quality of risk calculations

• Developing data quality checks within our in-house data models

• Improving existing tools and developing new solutions (primarily using SQL, Power BI, Power Automate, and Power Apps)

• Automating tasks related to reporting, data processing and analysis

• Supporting the risk business partners with daily ad hoc tasks and analysis

• Gaining exposure to different types of risks including liquidity, market, credit and operational risk

Your qualifications and personal skills:

• Currently enrolled in a bachelor’s or master’s degree in Economics, Finance, Mathematics or a similar field.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

• Ability to work independently and take initiative

• Coding skills are a plus but not required. The most important thing is an interest in learning, as much of the data work will involve SQL

• Interest in energy markets and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment

• Curious and open-minded approach to learning and problem-solving

Working in MFT Energy

At MFT Energy, we combine a startup mindset with the strength of a global organization. We believe in empowering individuals to make data-driven decisions in a fast-paced environment. We are around 200 employees working out of our headquarters in Scandinavian Center, Aarhus C, and from our international offices in Turkey, Australia, New York, Singapore, Japan, and several remote colleagues working from all over the world.

We offer:

• A 15–20-hour student position with flexibility to plan your working hours around your studies

• A role where you will take ownership of your tasks while working closely with experienced colleagues who are always ready to support and spar with you

• An international and fast-moving environment where things develop quickly and you will continuously learn new things

• A strong student community and plenty of social activities, such as CrossFit, running club, Friday bars, team events, and more

• A culture where we enjoy celebrating both big and small successes - and luckily, we have many reasons to do so

Make the most of your talent! Join us!

If you think there is a fit between the role and your aspirations, we will be looking forward to receiving your application with a short cover letter and CV. For questions, please write to career@mft-energy.com.

Deadline: We will be screening and interviewing candidates on an ongoing basis.

Start date: As soon as possible.

jobs.occupation: Associate Partner with a focus on operations and supply chain transformation, Copenhagen or Aarhus
jobs.description:
Experience

• Commercial growth

• Operations and Supply Chain

• Client Engagement

Are you passionate about helping clients solve complex supply chain challenges and create lasting business value? Do you combine deep functional expertise with commercial acumen, strong client relationships and leadership experience? Are you also curious about how AI, data and digital capabilities can strengthen future operations? Then you could play a key role in growing our Supply Chain & Operations practice and leading high-impact transformations.

About Valcon

We are a European powerhouse in AI and data-driven business transformation, bringing this to life by integrating management consulting with data and digital technology capabilities.

We ensure companies are in their best possible shape and fit for the future. We spot opportunities and help bring them to life. We are thorough, fast and collaborative in everything we do. From the boardroom to the shop floor. From strategy to operations.

We are a no-nonsense consultancy with curious individuals who are driven by creating value together with clients. We have an informal culture and a flat hierarchy with offices in Denmark, Sweden, the Netherlands, the UK, Germany, Croatia and Serbia.

To thrive in this role, you have demonstrated experience in these three competence areas:

• Commercial growth: Build strong client relationships, identify opportunities and contribute to the growth of existing and new client engagements through trusted advisory and business development activities

• Client engagement: Lead complex supply chain and operational improvement transformations from problem definition and solution design through implementation and value realization.

• Capability development: Help strengthen Supply Chain & Operations offerings, methodologies and market presence while leveraging AI, data and technology as key enablers of transformation

In addition, you should embody these skills:

• Supply Chain & Operations expertise: Deep experience within one or more areas such as Supply Chain Planning, S&OP, Logistics/Distribution, Procurement, Operational Excellence and Supply Chain Transformation

• People leadership: Build strong relationships, inspire teams and create an environment where people feel empowered, supported and motivated to perform

• Commercial and consulting acumen: Combine strategic thinking with a pragmatic delivery mindset and a strong understanding of how to create value for clients and grow trusted partnerships

• Digital mindset: Experience working with data, digital solutions and technology, or a strong curiosity about how these can enable better supply chain performance and business transformation

• Education: Relevant Master’s degree, fluent in English both written and spoken, Danish is a plus

Career opportunities

Valcon is in a significant growth phase supported by acquisitions and capital investment from Rivean Capital and Waterland Private Equity. This supports our ambitious expansion plans – both geographically and in terms of capabilities – with a particular focus on the Nordics and the DACH (German-speaking) region. Therefore, you will have a unique opportunity to help shape the company’s development and gain strategic influence over its future direction.

The role provides internal career development opportunities toward broader leadership roles within the capability or across the broader organisation. With Valcon’s international footprint and focus on complex Supply Chain and Operation projects in the business and technology space, you will gain access to:

• A broad network of colleagues and clients across Europe

• Strategically significant and high-complexity projects

• Opportunities to work with cutting-edge technology, including AI, data and digital technologies

Application

If this role sounds like a good match, we warmly encourage you to apply and share how your experience, strengths and perspective could contribute to the team. We review applications on an ongoing basis.

jobs.occupation: Senior Manager, Global Regulatory Operations, Process & Compliance
jobs.description:
At Genmab, we are dedicated to building extra[not]ordinary® futures, together, by developing antibody products and groundbreaking, knock-your-socks-off KYSO antibody medicines® that change lives and the future of cancer treatment and serious diseases. We strive to create, champion and maintain a global workplace where individuals’ unique contributions are valued and drive innovative solutions to meet the needs of our patients, care partners, families and employees.

Our people are compassionate, candid, and purposeful, and our business is innovative and rooted in science. We believe that being proudly authentic and determined to be our best is essential to fulfilling our purpose. Yes, our work is incredibly serious and impactful, but we have big ambitions, bring a ton of care to pursuing them, and have a lot of fun while doing so.

Does this inspire you and feel like a fit? Then we would love to have you join us!

**The Role

**Genmab is expanding into new markets, bringing increased activity and complexity across Global Regulatory Affairs (GRA). We have built a solid foundation within our Process & Compliance area, and we are now looking for a Senior Manager, Global Regulatory Operations, Process & Compliance to help us take the next step.

In this role, you will have the opportunity to influence both what we do and how we do it. You will help establish and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and Work Instructions (WIs), support GRA’s involvement in audits and inspections, and maintain oversight of GxP vendors and subcontractors.

You will also oversee Health Authority portal and database access supporting marketing authorization activities, while helping to optimize the related processes and tools. In addition, you will support a range of compliance activities across GRA. This is a senior individual contributor role, at Senior Manager level, reporting to the Associate Director, Global Regulatory Operations, Process & Compliance Lead.

**Responsibilities

**

• Develop and maintain GRA Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and Work Instructions (WIs).

• Represent GRA in process expert networks and coordinate GRA’s review of SOPs owned by other functional areas.

• Maintain GRA’s setup and oversight of GxP vendors and subcontractors.

• Maintain GRA’s setup and oversight of Health Authority portal and database access supporting marketing authorisation activities.

• Optimize processes and tools for our oversight activities.

• Coordinate GRA’s participation in regulatory audits and inspections, including preparation, participation and follow-up.

• Manage GRA compliance activities, including Functional Area Quality Events (QEs), QE process training and XEVMPD reporting.

• Act as the Training Subject Matter Expert (SME) for GRA.

**Requirements

**

• Minimum of 8 years of experience in Regulatory Affairs within the pharmaceutical industry, including 3 - 5 years in a comparable Regulatory Compliance role across the EU, US and/or Rest of World (RoW).

• Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Life Sciences, Pharmacy, Medicine or a related discipline.

• Experience with Regulatory Affairs activities across drug development and/or life-cycle management within a pharmaceutical company.

• Knowledge of laws, regulations and industry guidance relevant to the pharmaceutical industry.

• Strong organizational and prioritization skills, with the ability to manage multiple activities and deliver against timelines.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

• Strong interpersonal, teamwork, leadership and negotiation skills.

• Familiarity with project management and continuous process improvement techniques.

• Experience with GCP is considered an advantage. Experience coordinating regulatory inspections, audits and/or continuous improvement projects is also considered an advantage.

• Based in Denmark, with the ability to work 60% on-site at our Copenhagen headquarters.

The proposed gross annual/hourly base salary range for this position, in the primary location, based on a full time schedule is:

DKK636.480,00---954.720,00

The final salary offer will depend on several factors, including your skills, qualifications, and experience.

In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for additional forms of compensation, such as discretionary bonuses and long-term incentives.

**Benefits

**When you join Genmab, you become a part of a culture that supports your physical, financial, social, and emotional well-being. Our benefits include, but are not limited to:

• Pension

• Health insurance and wellness benefits

• Paid time off

• Employee support programs

Further details on eligibility for compensation and benefits based on the role will be provided during the recruitment process.

**About Genmab

**Genmab is an international biotechnology company with a core purpose to improve the lives of patients through innovative and differentiated antibody therapeutics. For 25 years, its hard-working, innovative and collaborative team has invented next-generation antibody technology platforms and harnessed translational, quantitative and data sciences, resulting in a proprietary pipeline including bispecific T-cell engagers, antibody-drug conjugates, next-generation immune checkpoint modulators and effector function-enhanced antibodies. By 2030, Genmab’s vision is to transform the lives of people with cancer and other serious diseases with Knock-Your-Socks-Off (KYSO®) antibody medicines.

Established in 1999, Genmab is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark with international presence across North America, Europe and Asia Pacific. For more information, please visit Genmab.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

Genmab is committed to protecting your personal data and privacy. Please see our privacy policy for handling your data in connection with your application on our website Job Applicant Privacy Notice (genmab.com).

At LIEWOOD, we want every product that carries our name to be safe, responsible and compliant – across global markets and in a regulatory landscape that is constantly evolving.

We are looking for a Product & Regulatory Compliance Specialist to ensure that our products meet legal, safety and regulatory requirements, and to help shape the future compliance agenda of a growing international children's lifestyle brand.

In this role you will combine strategic regulatory ownership with hands-on execution and translate complex legislation into practical business solutions.

The role

You will own product compliance across multiple product categories and keep LIEWOOD ahead of new and emerging legislation.

Working closely with suppliers, certification bodies, laboratories and regulatory consultants, you will lead testing strategies and certification activities, and make sure our technical documentation is solid and up to date.

You will also help build the compliance setup of tomorrow – developing processes, SOPs and knowledge-sharing frameworks, and supporting colleagues across Design, Buying and Production, so that safe and compliant products are built in from the start.

Your responsibilities

• Drive product safety and regulatory compliance throughout the product lifecycle

• Monitor and implement new regulatory requirements, including PPWR, GPSR, ESPR, DPP and other emerging legislation

• Lead testing strategies, laboratory coordination, certification activities and technical documentation

• Prepare and maintain technical files, Declarations of Conformity, risk assessments and compliance records

• Partner closely with suppliers, certification bodies, laboratories and regulatory consultants

• Support customer-specific compliance requirements and sustainability-related documentation

• Develop compliance processes, SOPs and knowledge-sharing frameworks

• Train and support internal stakeholders across Design, Buying and Production

• Identify, assess and escalate compliance risks while driving continuous improvement across compliance processes

Who are you?

You are curious, structured and highly detail-oriented. You enjoy solving complex problems, building scalable processes and turning regulatory requirements into practical solutions.

You thrive in a collaborative environment but are equally comfortable taking ownership and working independently.

We imagine that you bring:

• 3-5+ years of experience within Product Compliance, Regulatory Affairs, Product Safety or Quality Management

• Strong knowledge of EU product legislation and testing requirements

• Experience working with suppliers, manufacturers and testing laboratories

• Experience with one or more of the following areas: children's products, toys, electronics, PPE, textiles, Food Contact Materials or consumer products

• Experience implementing new regulatory requirements and managing product documentation

• Strong project management and stakeholder management skills

• Excellent communication skills and the ability to influence across functions

Experience with GOTS, GRS and FSC certification is an advantage.

Why join LIEWOOD?

At LIEWOOD, you'll have the opportunity to influence how compliance supports innovation and growth across a premium children's lifestyle brand. You'll work closely with passionate colleagues, take ownership of your area of expertise and help shape the future of product compliance in an evolving regulatory landscape.

LIEWOOD values responsibility, aesthetics, ambition, collaboration, professionalism and innovation.

The Company

˚MEQU is a Danish MedTech company behind the ˚M Warmer System, an innovative medical device that enables healthcare professionals to deliver warm blood and IV-fluids from the point of injury to the hospital. With customers across military, tactical, emergency, HEMS, and hospital environments worldwide, our ambition is to become the global leader in blood and IV-fluid warming solutions for pre-hospital and through hospital care. Learn more about ˚MEQU: www.mequ.dk

On behalf of ˚MEQU, Best Talent is recruiting an International Product Manager.

The Team

You will join a small, ambitious Marketing team with ambitious plans and great impact on the future growth of the company. Success is driven by close collaboration across Marketing, R&D, QA/RA, Operations, and Commercial functions in a fast moving and highly cross-functional environment.

International Product Manager

Drive global product strategy for an innovative Danish MedTech company

• Shape life-saving MedTech solutions through your clinical expertise

• Collaborate with leading healthcare providers, emergency services, and military organizations

• Play a key role in the international growth of a fast-scaling Danish MedTech company with a meaningful and global purpose

The Role

We are looking for an International Product Manager who can bridge clinical insights, users’ needs, regulatory requirements, and technical development to drive successful global product strategies and commercial execution.

You will own the global product lifecycle across emergency, tactical, and hospital segments. With the United States representing ˚MEQU’s most important growth market, you will play a key role in ensuring that product positioning, roadmap priorities, and value propositions algin with the clinical, regulatory, and commercial requirements of US military, EMS, HEMS, and hospital customers.

Working across the organization, you will ensure that user insights, market needs, engineering priorities and regulatory considerations are translated into clear product direction and commercially viable solutions.

As the internal subject-matter expert within pre-hospital blood and IV transfusion, you will convert clinical challenges into prioritized product requirements that guide product development and long-term portfolio decisions. The position reports directly to the COO and requires approximately 30-50 travel days annually.

Your key responsibilities will include:

• Shaping global product positioning, value propositions, and market prioritization to support successful international expansion, and continuously monitor:

• Developments in clinical standards of care.

• Tactical and military medical protocols.

• Global procurement and reimbursement structures.

• Competitive and technological developments.

• International market dynamics and commercial opportunities.

• Develop instructions for use, training materials, user guides, and educational content to support sales teams, distributors, and clinical specialists globally.

Your professional background:

You bring a clinical background within emergency medicine, pre-hospital care, HEMS, military medicine, or tactical care, combined with hands-on experience with blood and IV transfusion in critical settings. You understand the realities and challenges faced by end users in high-pressure environments.

In addition, you have commercial insight into the MedTech industry and experience supporting product positioning, launches, and international market development. Experience working with institutional customers medical device markets and understand how to position, launch, and scale products internationally. Experience with institutional and public procurement structures is highly valued.

You understand medical device development and the regulatory environment and are able to translate complex clinical needs into structured product requirements that create both customers value and commercial impact.

Your personality – You are:

• A strong communicator with who bridges clinical technical, regulatory, and commercial perspectives.

• Commercially minded with a strategic and customer-centric approach

• Structured and analytical, with the ability to balance long-term strategy and operational execution

• Proactive, self-driven, and comfortable taking ownership in a dynamic scale-up environment

• Curious, collaborative, and motivated by improving patient outcomes through innovation

˚MEQU offers you:

You will gain international exposure across tactical, emergency, and hospital markets and collaborate closely with global distributors, armed forces, and leading healthcare institutions.

• A high-impact position with global strategic product influence

• A dynamic, international, and collaborative work environment

• A diverse team of 30+ colleagues headquartered in Copenhagen

• A mission-driven culture focused on improving patient outcomes

• Competitive salary with a pension scheme and up-to-date benefits

Application:

Please send your application in English, marked ”1947/International Product Manager” to job@besttalent.dk. Interviews will be conducted on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. Learn more about Best Talent at www.besttalent.dk.

Do you want to help develop the future of automated communication solutions for utility meters? Are you ready to be challenged while gaining an exciting and educational internship experience? Do you want to contribute to real development projects?

Here is what the job entails

As an intern in Connectivity for Water solutions, you will work with a wide range of tasks within Kamstrup’s cellular and LoRa technology domain. A significant part of your work will involve supporting our development team with ongoing projects and activities.

More specifically, you will be:

• Supporting building prototypes using the latest technologies

• Working with embedded software development

• Collecting and analyzing test data for ongoing technology projects

• Exploring 4G/LTE technology primarily based on 3GPP CAT-M and NB-IoT

• Obtaining experience with LoRaWAN protocol

• Developing various scripts typically in Python

In this position you will have the opportunity to actively participate in ongoing projects in close collaboration with the other engineers and become an integrated part of the team. Your final tasks will be tailored to your competencies and interests, but you will work on real challenges that contribute to our development projects.

Meet your future team

As an intern in Connectivity for Water Solutions, you will join a strong and professional team of 12 experienced firmware engineers, dedicated to developing advanced communication technologies and maintaining the systems behind our solutions. We are always at the forefront of the latest methods in cellular solutions and embedded software. You will experience a collaborative work environment where knowledge sharing, curiosity and openness is part of everyday life, giving you great opportunities to grow professionally as well as personally.

Did you know? It is safe to say that you will work with the team in Kamstrup, that has the largest number of gadgets in the office!

Less about us, more about you

We are looking for a curious and ambitious intern who wants to put theory into practice and become part of a strong development environment. Maybe you dream of working with technology that makes a difference and are looking for a place where you can grow and take responsibility from day one.

To succeed, we imagine that you:

• Are studying a relevant degree within Electronics, Electrical Engineering, Software Engineering, or similar

• Have an interest in embedded software and technological development

• Work in a structured way and can handle multiple tasks simultaneously

• Are a good communicator who thrives in collaboration across different levels of the organization

• Have a proactive mindset and get motivated by exploring new technologies, which requires new solutions and software development

As we are an international organisation it is important that you are fluent in English.

Whilst you may not meet all the qualifications listed above, this is an internship position, and we value curiosity and a willingness to learn just as much as experience. If the role interests you and you are motivated to grow, we encourage you to apply.

We offer more than just an internship

At Kamstrup, your contribution as an intern is highly valued, and we cherish the good colleagueship. Therefore, you will experience an internship with a strong focus on your individual development through challenging tasks, career sparring, voluntary courses, as well as social events and a large network. We are proud, that our internship program has resulted in Studenterhus Aarhus granting us with the Mentor Award, the Internationalization Award, the Jury’s Special Award and the award for East Jutland’s Best internship.

Besides the best program, we also offer:

• The internship is paid if your place of study allows it

• Multiple internship events and weekly internship lunches

• Employee benefits including a healthy canteen, fitness facilities, in-house dental clinic, hairdresser, and a free health clinic

• An active employee association, that fosters a collaborative and supportive workplace community

Do you want to be a part of Kamstrup?

The applications are reviewed on a continuous basis, but you can expect a response within six weeks. Details about the internship will be agreed upon individually. However, the internship is expected to run from the beginning of February 2027 until the end of June 2027.

Kamstrup Head Quarter is in Stilling south of Aarhus, and bus number 200 takes you right to the door.

In case of questions regarding the position, please contact Functional Lead - Connectivity Technology, Lead Specialist, Jonas Drammestrup Poulsen, on phone: +45 89 93 10 00.

Build Intelligent Systems That Create Real Impact

Are you motivated by solving complex problems with data and AI?

Do you enjoy transforming business challenges into scalable, production-ready solutions?

At VENZO, we’re expanding our Data & AI team and are looking for experienced profiles across mid-to-senior level — from strong hands-on engineers to technical leaders who can shape architecture and guide others.

If you want your work to move beyond experimentation and into real-world implementation, this could be the right place for you.

About VENZO

At VENZO, we believe in the power of technology to create meaningful change – today, not tomorrow.

You’ll join a team of specialists who live and breathe digital transformation, helping some of Denmark’s largest and most influential organizations turn data into action. Here, innovation isn’t a buzzword – it’s how we think, collaborate, and deliver.

About the Role

You will contribute directly to the design, development, and deployment of advanced data and AI systems in cloud-based environments.

Your responsibilities may include:

• Architecting and implementing end-to-end AI and machine learning solutions

• Deploying, monitoring, and optimizing models on cloud platforms

• Translating business requirements into structured technical solutions

• Ensuring solutions are maintainable, scalable, and aligned with best practices

• Evaluating and applying emerging technologies within AI and GenAI

For more senior candidates, the role also includes:

• Defining technical direction and architectural standards

• Acting as a primary technical contact for clients

• Leading workstreams and mentoring team members

• Contributing to the evolution of our Data & AI capabilities and service offerings

We value profiles who can combine deep technical execution with sound judgment in real client environments.

Your Background

We are open to different experience levels, provided you bring strong fundamentals and practical experience.

Experience and Education

• Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or equivalent practical experience

• 2+ years of experience in data engineering or AI/ML, delivering production-ready solutions

• Hands-on experience across the full ML lifecycle — from experimentation to deployment and monitoring

• Experience with generative AI

• For senior profiles: experience leading technical initiatives or mentoring others

Technical Capabilities

You have experience working within modern data and AI ecosystems, including:

• Programming: Python and SQL, Typescript is a plus

• Cloud: Microsoft Azure (e.g., Azure ML, Data Factory) or other cloud plattforms

• Databricks (Spark, Delta Lake, MLflow)

• Machine Learning: Classical ML techniques and generative AI applications

• GenAI Tooling: LLM APIs, prompt engineering, RAG patterns, frameworks such as LangChain or Microsoft Agent Framework

• MLOps: CI/CD, model lifecycle management, orchestration tools, version control

• Data Engineering: ETL processes and large-scale data processing

How You Work

• Analytical and structured in your problem-solving approach

• Comfortable operating in client-facing environments

• Able to communicate complex technical topics in business-relevant terms

• Pragmatic, quality-driven, and accountable for outcomes

What You Can Expect From Us

• Meaningful, technically challenging projects with real business visibility

• A strong professional environment with high standards and high trust

• Autonomy in how you structure and deliver your work

• Access to modern tooling, platforms, and certifications (including Microsoft)

• Competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits

• Continuous development — technically and professionally

Let’s Talk

Send your CV or a short introduction to hr@venzo.com.

We’re happy to meet for a coffee and explore whether there’s a mutual fit.

Do you want hands-on experience of how innovative products move from idea to market? Are you eager to work with smart metering solutions that combine intelligent meters, software, data analytics, and services? Are you looking for an internship in an international green tech organization where your development truly matters?

Here is what your role entails

As a Product Management Intern, you will gain hands-on experience shaping our diverse product portfolio within smart metering, which includes intelligent meters, advanced software solutions, data analytics, and services. Moreover, you will gain practical experience across both strategic and operational product management, working closely with various stakeholders, including Product Managers, Research & Development, Sales, and customers.

More specifically, you will be:

• Gathering and analyzing customer, market, and competitor insights

• Supporting product roadmaps, business cases, project plans, and documentation

• Helping define requirements for new meters, software solutions, and services

• Contributing to innovation and early-stage development projects

• Tracking progress across product initiatives and communicating key updates

In this role, you will develop a comprehensive understanding of product management processes covering areas like hardware software, data and services. Furthermore, you will contribute to projects with real business impact while working closely with stakeholders across both functions and countries. As this is an internship position, you will also have the opportunity to explore your own ideas and interests within the scope of your responsibilities.

Meet your future team

You will become part of our two Product Management teams in the Water department, consisting of 16 dedicated colleagues in total. Together, we work with solutions that combine intelligent meters, digital platforms, software, and services. In our work, we inspire each other through the sharing of diverse perspectives and ideas that make our projects stronger and more exciting. Both teams have an informal and open culture where creativity is encouraged, questioning the status quo is welcomed, and exploring new approaches is part of the job.

Did you know? Our team is characterized by diverse international backgrounds, with employees representing five different countries.

Less about us, more about you

We are looking for a proactive and motivated student who is curious about technology and innovation and eager to learn more about product management in practice. Furthermore, through interaction with customers, you can understand customer needs, and help turn those insights into impactful projects and solutions.

In order to succeed, we imagine that you:

• Are pursuing a degree within Engineering, Business, Innovation, IT, or a related field

• Have an interest in technology, products, and customer-centric innovation

• Possess strong analytical and communication skills

• Enjoy collaborating with stakeholders from different backgrounds and cultures

• Have an interest in how AI can be applied in everyday work

As we are an international organization it is important that you are fluent in English.

Whilst you may not meet all the qualifications listed above, this is an internship position, and we value curiosity and a willingness to learn just as much as experience. If the role interests you and you are motivated to grow, we encourage you to apply.

Do you love designing clean game architecture, building multiplayer systems that run smoothly, and helping a team of programmers make the right technical decisions? Great! Let’s talk.

Triband is the award-winning studio behind the WHAT THE? comedy game series, played by millions worldwide. From our home in central Copenhagen, more than 60 wonderful humans are united by a simple mission: to make everyone laugh.

We're building something unannounced, exciting, thoroughly goofy, and built to be played together online. We're now looking for a Lead Game Programmer to help building the underlying systems that make it all work, from the core architecture to the multiplayer tech that connects our players. You'll stay hands-on in the code and the Unity editor while helping the programming team make good technical decisions, stay aligned, and build systems that support creative experimentation. And just to be very clear: this is a technical leadership role, not a people-management position.

**Here’s What That Looks Like Day To Day

**

• In collaboration with game designers, artists, and other programmers, you’ll build new features and systems and continuously iterate on improvements. We all work in Unity with C#, with every team member hands-on in the editor

• You’ll set and communicate the project’s technical direction, turning creative goals and production needs into clear technical priorities

• You’ll help the programming team make architectural decisions, align around shared patterns, and navigate trade-offs between long-term code health and short-term needs

• You’ll review and improve technical solutions, share best practices, and support other programmers without becoming a gatekeeper or bottleneck

• You’ll proactively identify technical risks, messy systems, and missing foundations, and take responsibility for addressing them at the right time

• Overall, you’ll make sure the project is technically healthy and maintain the codebase in a way that makes it easy for others to build on

**This includes things like...

**

• Designing an architecture that allows for easy gameplay implementation and flexibility

• Implementing and maintaining online features such as matchmaking, invites and friends

• Profiling and improving network performance, bandwidth and latency, and making sure the game holds up on real-world connections

• Breaking down complex technical challenges, helping decide what to prioritise, and ensuring important decisions are understood by the people they affect

• Staying close to the actual game: writing production code, debugging difficult problems, and improving systems as the project evolves

**You’re a great match if

**

• You have at least ten years of professional game development experience across multiple shipped games and different stages of development, including significant technical ownership or leadership on a project

• You have experience setting technical direction and helping a programming team make and implement architectural decisions, with strong judgment in balancing flexibility, maintainability, performance and the needs of a creative production

• You're highly proficient in C# and have deep knowledge of the Unity engine and editor

• You've shipped at least one online multiplayer game, had real ownership of its networking/online systems, and have hands-on experience with a Unity multiplayer framework (e.g., Coherence)

• You communicate clearly and can explain technical decisions and trade-offs to programmers and non-programmers alike

**Nice to haves

**

• You have experience shipping iOS and macOS apps, including hands-on integration of Apple platform services such as GameKit and the Game Controller framework using Xcode and Swift

• Experience with backend services, dedicated servers or cloud hosting for online games

• Interest in multiplayer game design and social features

• Experience working with automated build pipelines such as Jenkins

• Experience building systemic or open-world games

**What Always Matters To Us At Triband

**

• You thrive in taking ownership of your area: you spot problems, seek advice when needed, and implement creative solutions that push projects forward

• You’re motivated by collaboration, mutual respect, inclusiveness and creativity while actively contributing to sustaining that culture

• You believe games are made by teams, not rockstars and that great ideas can come from anyone

• You bring curiosity, generosity, and flexibility, along with strong opinions, especially when they come with reasoning, openness, and a willingness to actually test them

• You love exploration and experimentation but don’t get too precious when the evidence tells you you’re wrong

• You value a positive work environment and contribute to keeping the studio a fun and supportive place to be

**Practicalities

**

• We work on-site at our cozy office in central Copenhagen.

• For this role we also consider people located outside of Denmark and provide financial (and moral!) support with visa application and relocation.

• We work a 37-hour work week, with core hours 10-15, and the freedom to start and finish anywhere between 7 and 18.

• Our working language is English.

**We offer

**

• Silly but ambitious projects, and the chance to work on and impact great games that reach millions of players.

• A playful and ambitious work environment where experimentation is encouraged.

• Friendly and kind colleagues who love making each other laugh as much as making games.

• A professional development budget to invest in your growth.

• Social activities like Friday bars, hobby nights, board game nights, team events, you name it.

• Daily lunch at a local restaurant just a walk across the lakes away, with plant-based options (and soft ice on Thursdays).

• Six weeks of vacation (five standard plus one extra on us).

• Paid parental leave at full salary for the periods covered by state reimbursement.

• Child's first sick day on us, no questions asked.

• Pension plan and private health insurance.

• Endless amounts of Faxe Kondi.

From our home in central Copenhagen, more than 60 wonderful humans are united by our mission to make everyone laugh. To do so, we focus on exploring comedy through gameplay. We like to break player expectations, use wonderful music, slick art, and create a quirky atmosphere. We experiment a lot, and it doesn't always work out, but we always learn something.

We put people first and strive to create a safe and creative working environment. We believe that teams, not individuals, make games, and we believe diversity makes for better teams. For these reasons, we look for people who bring new perspectives and will challenge us and our way of doing things.

31 October 2026 , 23:59 CET

Office-based

_

Join us in this role where you’ll be responsible of collecting and processing data from our energy assets at Skærbæk Power Station. We’re undertaking a digitalization and modernization effort to automate, improve, and standardize our data processing to ensure high data quality. In this role regular physical visits to our locations at Avedøre Power Station and in the Gentofte office should be expected.

**Welcome to Bioenergy

We have workplaces in Skærbæk, Gentofte, and at Avedøre Power Station, and we visit our energy assets on site when needed. Data & Application is part of Digitalisation & Technology, offering a collaborative environment with passionate and skilled colleagues. As a team, we in close dialogue with colleagues across the organization. We work hybrid: daily coordination on MS Teams and workplaces in Skærbæk, other sites, or from home as needed.

You’ll play an important role in:

• being data responsible for Skærbæk Power Station — ensuring relevant data is available for reporting and settlement

• utilizing technical insight to ensure complete, correct & validated data

• monitoring and reporting CO₂ emissions, including validating data, maintaining traceable documentation, and ensuring compliance with applicable legislation

• managing flue gas emissions data and reporting, including follow-up on emission limits, permit conditions and regulatory documentation

• participating in process optimization incl. knowledge sharing across the team.

To succeed in the role, you:

• possess a highly curious and analytical mindset, with a strong interest in process engineering and data reporting

• enjoy combining practical understanding of energy assets with data analysis. You hold an educational background within process-/operation and maintenance engineering, mathematics or equivalent

• strive by handling multiple tasks simultaneously with a proactively and systematically mindset and approach

• possess strong numerical skills and are persevering in finding solutions to tasks given

• strive by working both independently as well as part of a team

The offered base salary will be determined within this range based on relevant skills, experience, and expected role fulfilment within the stated pay range to ensure a fair and competitive offer. As Senior IT Windows Server Architect, you will set the vision for the Windows Server operating system platform across Novo Nordisk, and turn it into a roadmap. You will be the architectural authority for two segregated environments: the General Network for enterprise IT services and the Production Network for business-critical production systems. Your decisions will shape how the platform is designed, secured, automated and run for years to come, keeping the systems our business depends on stable every day.

What you’ll bring

You are an established architect who has already set direction for Windows Server platforms in large enterprise companies. You will bring:

· A proven track record in architecture roles, such as Windows Server Architect or Infrastruc-ture Architect, in large, complex enterprise organisations.

· A clear, well-reasoned vision for building a best-in-class Windows Server operating system platform, and the ability to turn that vision into roadmaps, standards and decisions.

· Deep expertise in Windows Server architecture and engineering at scale, including Active Di-rectory, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, PKI/certificate services and Windows authentication.

· Expert knowledge of Windows Server security and hardening, privileged access and adminis-trative security models, risk management and lifecycle management.

· Experience architecting high availability, clustering, backup, disaster recovery and resilience for business-critical production environments.

· Experience designing for strict network segregation, including segmentation, firewalls, load balancing and secure communication between network zones.

· A strong grasp of virtualisation (preferably VMware and/or Hyper-V), monitoring and enter-prise management platforms, PowerShell automation and patching architecture.

· The ability to translate business, security and operational requirements into practical archi-tecture, document it clearly and win support for it across teams.

Useful, but not essential:

· Experience with Azure, Azure Arc, hybrid infrastructure, Infrastructure as Code, configuration management and modern automation platforms (highly desirable).

· Experience from regulated, manufacturing, pharmaceutical, financial, healthcare or other highly controlled environments.

What you’ll do

Together with the product owner, you will decide where the platform goes next. This is a strate-gic architecture role, not day-to-day server administration. You will:

· Own the enterprise Windows Server architecture, vision, roadmap and standards across the General and Production environments.

· Define and govern secure, standardised platforms, covering configuration, networking, stor-age, virtualisation, monitoring, backup and recovery.

· Set the security architecture and hardening standards for privileged access, authentication, service accounts, certificates, vulnerability management and compliance.

· Design architectures for segregated networks with secure integrations, controlled access, and high availability and disaster recovery standards that meet business recovery objectives.

· Lead modernisation, including upgrades, migrations, automation, Infrastructure as Code and reducing technical debt.

· Act as the senior technical authority, leading architectural governance and design reviews, and guiding infrastructure, security and application teams.

Who you’ll work with

You will join the Server Platform sub-department within Infrastructure Platforms, part of Enter-prise IT & Quality. The team operates and manages all enterprise servers at Novo Nordisk, cov-ering Windows and Linux in both public and private cloud. Its goal is to streamline server opera-tions across platforms and domains, so they run fast, reliably and in line with compliance re-quirements.

You will work with colleagues in the Philippines, India, Poland, the Czech Republic, Denmark and the United States. Alongside the product owner, you will partner with infrastructure engineer-ing, operations, cybersecurity, network, application, cloud and enterprise architecture teams. Your job is to bring them together around clear architectural decisions and move them forward.

Your hiring manager will be [insert hiring manager name and title].

What you can expect here

You will own the architecture of a platform the whole company relies on. You will be trusted to set direction, challenge convention and make your voice heard, then commit with the team once a decision is made. Working across two very different environments and a global team, you will keep building your skills as the platform moves towards hybrid cloud and automation.

jobs.occupation: A Post doc position is available in the Grønbæk Group at Biotech Research and Innovation Centre (BRIC),
jobs.description:
We are searching for a skilled and experienced post doc with specific interest in investigating early myeloid disease, clonal haematopoiesis, metabolism and obesity.

  Our research/The group

  The focus of the Grønbæk group is Translational Haematology. The group is affiliated with Biotech Research and Innovation centre (BRIC), University of Copenhagen and Rigshospitalet (Central Copenhagen University Hospital). 

  Our overall aim is to understand the molecular mechanisms of haematological cancers and based on this; to design, develop and implement novel, scientifically based, clinical trials, with a strong focus on epigenetic therapies. This is done by bridging between clinical research at Rigshospitalet and the basic cancer biology research at BRIC, and in international collaborations with, among others, the Van Andel Research Institute, Michigan, USA and the Nordic MDS study group.

  Our location at the Copenhagen Biocentre/BRIC provides optimal conditions for interaction with the basic scientists at BRIC. The group currently consists of 14 scientists, MD/scientists and students, one clinical research coordinator, 1 research nurse and 2 biomedical laboratory scientists.

   

  The project: Deciphering the Mechanistic Links Between Obesity, Clonal Haematopoiesis and Myeloid Neoplasms.

  The current position is part of a joint project ‘Deciphering the Mechanistic Links Between Obesity, Clonal Haematopoiesis and Myeloid Neoplasms’ together with Professor George Vassiliou, Cambridge Stem Cell Institute, University of Cambridge, United Kingdom funded by a ‘Molecular Mechanisms Linking Obesity and Cancer (MMLOC)’ grant from the Novo Nordisk foundation, which supports collaborative research projects with the purpose ‘to reverse-translate clinical observations into mechanistic studies that will increase our understanding of how obesity impacts carcinogenesis’.

  Obesity is a global health issue linked to increased risk of cancer, including blood cancers such as myeloid neoplasms (MN). Many MN arise from clonal haematopoiesis (CH)—the abnormal expansion of blood stem cell clones carrying somatic mutations. Haematopoietic stem cells interact with bone marrow adipose tissue (BMAT), which increases with obesity, which may fuel CH growth and progression to MN. Epidemiological and genetic studies already suggest obesity accelerates CH, but the underlying mechanisms remain unclear.

  This project integrates large-scale population data, clinical trials, and mechanistic mouse studies to investigate these links and explore preventive or therapeutic strategies.

   

  Your job

  The project focuses on translational analyses of live frozen human cells from patient bone marrow (BM)/(BMAT) and blood samples from completed and ongoing clinical trials. We are searching for a skilled post doc who is very interactive and enjoys collaborations with other scientists – including younger scientists and clinician scientists.

  Your tasks will include:

   	
• Process of live frozen patient material from clinical trials including isolation of defined cell populations, and quality control for downstream omics 	
• Perform in-house molecular techniques which may include Proteomics, PCR, ddPCR, and library/sample preparation for RNA-seq, ATAC-seq and DNA methylation analyses 	
• Coordinate genomic, transcriptomic, lipidomic, metabolomic analyses with our internal and external collaborating laboratories and take the lead on designing relevant sub-studies, integrating and interpreting the data 	
• Help establish the practical and regulatory framework for these collaborations, including material transfer and data-sharing agreements 	
• Participate in grant and manuscript writing 	
• Present at local and international meetings 	
• Introduce lab techniques to new lab members and students 	
• Collaborate with both scientists and clinicians   Start: February 1st, 2027

  Duration: 2 years

  Profile

  We expect you to be a highly motivated and highly ambitious, independent scientist with the following qualifications: •

   	
• A PhD in Life Sciences with a preferred focus on haematology 	
• A strong background in mechanisms of normal and malignant haematopoiesis and molecular haematology techniques 	
• Comprehensive lab skills in molecular and cellular biology techniques, including work with primary human cells and cryopreserved patient material 	
• Experience with genomics, transcriptomics, proteomics, lipidomics, metabolomics and ability to analyse and interpret such data 	
• Experience with running projects across research groups 	
• Strong publication and presentation record in peer reviewed journals and international conferences 	
• Excellent written and spoken English skills 	
• Very collaborative 	
• Good social skills     

  Place of employment
 The workplace is at the Bartholin Institute which is part of Rigshospitalet, University of Copenhagen. The Bartholin Institute is located at Copenhagen Biocentre/BRIC, close to the centre of Copenhagen. We offer creative and stimulating working conditions in a dynamic and international research environment. Our research facilities include modern laboratories and a number of core facilities (animal unit, flow cytometry, in vivo imaging, NGS, etc.) shared between the research groups at BRIC (www.bric.ku.dk) and the neighbouring Finsen Laboratory. We have weekly journal clubs, data clubs, seminars with invited speakers and a young researchers club ASAP and our own PhD programme, MoMeD.

   

  Terms of employment 
 The position is a fixed-term position limited to a period of two years. The starting date is 01.02.2027 or after agreement.
 Salary, pension and other conditions of employment are set in accordance with the Agreement between the Ministry of Taxation and AC (Danish Confederation of Professional Associations) or other relevant organisation. Currently, the monthly salary starts at 39,900 DKK/approx. 5,300 EUR (August 2026 level). Depending on qualifications, a supplement may be negotiated. The employer will pay an additional 18,07 % to your pension fund.

  Foreign and Danish applicants may be eligible for tax reductions, if they hold a PhD degree and have not lived in Denmark the last 10 years.

  The position is covered by the Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities 2025

   

  Questions 

  For further information regarding the position, please contact Professor Kirsten Grønbæk, kirsten groenbaek@regionh.dk; phone + 4535456086 / +4525211598.

  Foreign applicants may find this link useful: www.ism.ku.dk (International Staff Mobility).

   

  Application
 The application must include the following documents/attachments – all in PDF format:

  1. Motivated letter of application (max. one page).

  2. CV incl. education, work/research experience, language skills and other skills relevant for the position.

  3. A certified/signed copy of a) PhD certificate and b) Master of Science certificate. If the PhD is not completed, a written statement from the supervisor will do.

  4. List of publications.

   

  Recommendation 
 Furthermore, the applicant should provide two letters of recommendation or two references. To be taken into consideration, the letters must be signed by the supporting person on paper with institutional letter head and in PDF-format.

   

  Application deadline 15 November 2026, 23.59pm CET.

  We reserve the right not to consider material received after the deadline, and not to consider applications 3 of 4 or letters of recommendation that do not live up to the above-mentioned requirements.

   

  The further process

  After the expiry of the deadline for applications, the authorized recruitment manager selects applicants for assessment on the advice of the hiring committee. All applicants are then immediately notified whether their application has been passed for assessment by an unbiased assessor. Once the assessment work has been completed each applicant has the opportunity to comment on the part of the assessment that relates to the applicant him/herself. You can read about the recruitment process at http://employment.ku.dk/faculty/recruitment-process/

  The applicant will be assessed according to the Ministerial Order no. 242 of 13 March 2012 on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities.

   

  The University of Copenhagen wish to reflect the diversity of society and encourage all qualified candidates to apply regardless of personal background.

Are you excited by the opportunity to work with data, AI and modern analytics tools in an international green-tech company? Does gaining hands-on experience with Power BI, ServiceNow and Claude AI sound like the perfect foundation for your future career?

Here is what your role entails

As our new Data Analyst Intern, your responsibility will be to help Customer Services transform data into insights that support business decisions and continuous improvements.

More specifically, you will be:

• Analyzing Customer Services performance

• Identifying improvement opportunities

• Tracking costs and income streams

• Developing dashboards and tracking KPIs

• Exploring data-driven and AI opportunities

This internship offers the opportunity to work with real business challenges, where your insights create impact. You will gain hands-on experience with technologies and platforms such as Power BI, ServiceNow and Claude AI while helping shape a newly established area with plenty of room for learning and development. Furthermore, you will have the opportunity to influence your focus areas throughout the internship based on your interests and development goals.

Meet your future team

With direct reference to Head of Service Development - Heat/Cooling Customer Services, you will become part of a newly established team in Customer Services focused on service development, business processes, and data analysis. Together our mission is to enable Customer Services to continuously improve how we deliver, support, and develop services. Did you know? In our team, we have many different talents – we have both a former professional drummer, a race car driver and one of the best board game players in Denmark, just to name a few.

Less about us, more about you

We are looking for a curious and analytical student who enjoys working with data and turning insights into action. You are motivated by solving real business challenges and eager to explore how data and AI can create value in practice.

In order to succeed, we imagine that you:

• Hold a degree in Data Science, Business Intelligence, Business Analytics, Economics, or a related field

• Have strong analytical skills and is comfortable working with quantitative data

• Have an interest in working with AI and tools such as Power BI or similar visualization tools
