Whilst you may not meet all the qualifications listed above, this is an internship position, and we value curiosity and a willingness to learn just as much as experience. If the role interests you and you are motivated to grow, we encourage you to apply.

We offer more than just an internship

At Kamstrup, your contribution as an intern is highly valued, and we cherish the good colleagueship. Therefore, you will experience an internship with a strong focus on your individual development through challenging tasks, career sparring, voluntary courses, as well as social events and a large network. We are proud, that our internship program has resulted in Studenterhus Aarhus granting us with the Mentor Award, the Internationalization Award, the Jury’s Special Award and the award for East Jutland’s Best Internship.

Besides the best program, we also offer:

• A gratuity which may be provided in recognition of your efforts if your place of study allows it as well as paid public transportation to and from work

• Multiple internship events and weekly internship lunches

• Employee benefits including a healthy canteen, fitness facilities, in-house dental clinic, hairdresser, and a free health clinic

• An active employee association, that fosters a collaborative and supportive workplace community

Do you want to be a part of Kamstrup?

The applications are reviewed on a continuous basis, but you can expect a response within six weeks. Any details about the internship will be individually agreed upon. However, the internship is expected to run from the beginning of February 2027 until the end of June 2027.

Kamstrup is located in Stilling south of Aarhus, and bus number 200 takes you right to the door.

If you have any questions about the position, please contact Senior Director, Customer Services - Heat/Cooling, Kirstine Tronhjem Rod, on telephone nr.: (+45) 89 93 10 00.

Directure is an international management consulting firm devoted to advising and assisting organisations within life science, healthcare and other regulated industries, to realise their strategy aspirations. We operate through an integrated approach to consulting, combining best practice standards and disciplines of Management Consulting, International Search and People Resource Consulting. Today, Directure advises a variety of companies that seek guidance and counselling on business and senior leadership needs with an increasing access to executives around the world. We combine the in-depth expertise of an international advisor with the focus and flexibility of a boutique consulting firm that has put impact above size.

Coordinator / Associate

The Role

Part Coordinator, part Associate — all inside the work

Directure's consultants run complex, multi-client advisory practices. They need someone close — someone who keeps the operational side running with precision while also contributing to the substantive work: research, analysis, and the polished outputs clients receive.

This Associate/Coordinator role sits at the intersection of those two things. You will own the administrative infrastructure that makes consultants effective — diary, travel, planning, correspondence — and you will contribute directly to client deliverables: desk research, data synthesis, and advanced PowerPoint presentations built to a consulting standard.

It is an unusual position, and deliberately so. You will see the full arc of consulting engagements, from brief to delivery, without the distance that typical coordinator roles create. For the right person — organised, analytical, and ambitious — it is an accelerated route into consulting work.

Responsibilities

Two distinct, equally important areas of work

Administration & Coordination

• Own and manage a complex partner and consultant diaries — scheduling, sequencing, and protecting time for deep work

• Plan and coordinate all travel: flights, accommodation, ground logistics, and changes in the field

• Prepare meeting agendas, briefing notes, and follow-up actions; manage correspondence independently where appropriate

• Track project timelines, upcoming milestones, and internal team deadlines across active engagements

• Administrative coordination with Finance.

• Maintain organised filing systems and document libraries for ongoing project matters

Research, Analysis & Presentations

• Conduct desk research on industries, markets, competitors, and regulatory environments in support of client engagements

• Synthesise findings into structured summaries and analytical frameworks ready for review

• Build and maintain advanced PowerPoint presentations — slide logic, visual hierarchy, data visualisation — to a standard appropriate for senior client audiences

• Support data gathering and basic modelling tasks using Excel

• Assist in preparing pitch materials, proposals, and thought-leadership content

• Quality-check outputs before client delivery: language, consistency, and visual finish

What We're Looking For

Skills, background, and ways of working

• An academic degree and experience in a professional services, consulting, corporate, or equivalent environment — you understand what high-standard output looks like

• Strong PowerPoint skills are essential: you can build a structured, visually coherent presentation from a brief, not just populate a template

• Research-literate — comfortable gathering, assessing, and structuring information from multiple sources into something useful for decision-making

• Organised in a way that holds under pressure: priorities shift, deadlines accelerate, and you adapt without dropping things

• Excellent written communication in English; your drafts need minimal editing before they go out

• Proficient in Microsoft 365 — Outlook, Teams, Word, Excel, PowerPoint — and quick to learn tools you haven't used before

• Discreet and professional in your handling of sensitive information; you understand what confidentiality means in a client-facing environment

• Curious about the work itself — you want to understand the engagements you're supporting, not just manage the calendar around them

Why This Role

What you get from working here

Directure is a small firm doing substantive work. That means the hierarchy is flat, the access is real, and your contributions are visible. You will not spend years waiting to be close to the interesting problems.This role is structured for someone who is serious about building a career in consulting — or who wants to develop a professional practice that sits across organisational and analytical work.

The remuneration reflects your qualifications.

How to Apply

Please send your CV and a brief cover letter under reference "CA" via e-mail to career@directure.com. Please note that we will invite, interview and select among candidates on an ongoing basis. We look forward to receiving your application, which will be treated in strictest confidence.

For more information about Directure please visit: www.directure.com

Non-Key Expert – Administrative, Logistics & Project Support Expert

NTU International is preparing a proposal for the project “Support to the Africa-EU Space Partnership Programme – AESPP Boost.”

The programme aims to strengthen cooperation between Africa and the European Union in the space sector, supporting policy dialogue, institutional partnerships, knowledge exchange, innovation, private sector engagement and investment, while contributing to stronger and more sustainable African space ecosystems.

In this context, we are seeking a qualified Non-Key Expert – Administrative, Logistics & Project Support Expert to provide administrative, operational and logistical support to programme implementation, including contract and activity monitoring, financial reporting support, organisation of meetings and events, and coordination of project-related activities.

Minimum Qualifications and Skills:

• University degree of at least three years in administration, project management, finance, communication, social sciences, or a related field. In the absence of such degree, three additional years of relevant professional experience.

• Excellent command of English.

• Working knowledge of French and/or Portuguese will be considered an asset.

Minimum General Professional Experience:

• Minimum 3 years of professional experience in project administration, contract and project monitoring, logistics and/or operational support.

Minimum Specific Professional Experience:

• At least 1 year of professional experience supporting donor-funded or international programmes, with contract and activity monitoring, financial reporting support and organisation of meetings, webinars, workshops, missions and/or events. Experience in Africa is an asset.

If you are interested in this opportunity, please apply and upload your CV via LinkedIn or send to recruitment@ntu.eu. Please note that only selected candidates will be contacted due to the large amount of applicants.

jobs.occupation: Senior Trader, Continental Europe & UK Power
jobs.description:
Application deadline

26th October 2026 , 23:59 CET

Country Denmark

Location Gentofte

Workplace

Hybrid (office and home-working)

_

We offer a workplace culture where you´ll arrange with your people leader when you can work from home and from the office.

_

Working hours full-time

Employment type Permanent

Legal entity Ørsted Salg & Service A/S

Why join?

Proven very high employee satisfaction and motivation

Continuous development opportunities for all employees

Competitive salary, pension scheme, and attractive holiday package

A wide range of health benefits, such as health insurance, nutritious food, and fitness facilities in our office locations

Join us in this role where you have ownership of trading strategies across Continental European and UK power markets, generating value through fundamental and quantitative insights while contributing to the transition to a renewable energy future.

As a Senior Trader, you'll operate within a defined risk mandate, identify and capture opportunities across the power curve, and help shape the future direction of our discretionary and systematic trading strategies. You'll work at the intersection of market intelligence, analytics, and technology, combining deep market understanding with innovative trading approaches to deliver strong commercial results.

Welcome to Market Trading

You'll become part of Continental & UK Trading, where we generate value through trading across European power, carbon, and gas markets. The team combines experienced traders, analysts, quants, and developers, creating an environment where market insights, data-driven decision making, and innovation come together.

In this role, you'll focus on Continental European and UK power curve products, leveraging your understanding of market fundamentals, cross-commodity relationships, and risk dynamics to identify and execute profitable trading opportunities.

As a team, we're ambitious, collaborative, and highly performance-oriented. We challenge each other's thinking, share knowledge openly, and continuously adapt to changing market conditions. This creates an exciting environment for experienced traders looking to make an impact while continuing to develop professionally.

You’ll play an important role in:

• delivering strong trading performance across Continental and UK power markets within an allocated risk mandate

• developing and executing trading strategies across forward and futures markets, with a particular focus on curve products

• identifying market opportunities through analysis of power fundamentals, weather, cross-border flows, fuel markets, carbon pricing, and broader macroeconomic developments

• helping shape and enhance systematic trading capabilities by collaborating closely with quantitative analysts and algorithmic developers

• actively managing risk and ensuring disciplined position management under changing market conditions

• translating market developments into actionable trading decisions and commercial outcomes.

To succeed in the role, you:

• have significant experience trading European power markets, especially Continental European and/or UK markets

• have a proven track record of delivering results within a delegated trading mandate and managing risk effectively

• possess a strong understanding of power market fundamentals and the key drivers influencing curve valuations

• can develop clear market views and translate them into profitable trading strategies

• combine strong analytical and numerical capabilities with sound commercial judgement

• are comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment where decisions must be made under uncertainty

• thrive in close collaboration with traders, analysts, quants, and developers

• communicate openly, challenge constructively, and contribute positively to a high-performing team culture.

Maybe you’ve read the above and can see you have some transferable skills, even though they don’t quite match all the points. If you think you can bring something to the team, we still encourage you to apply.

**Shape the future with us

**Send your application to us as soon as possible. We’ll be conducting interviews on a continuous basis and reserve the right to take down the advert when we’ve found the right candidate.

As an applicant or employee, you may request reasonable work and position accommodation or adjustments via accommodation@orsted.com.

Please note that for your application to be taken into consideration, you must submit your application via our online career pages and answer the screening questions relevant for your country. We don't take applications or inquiries from external recruiters or agencies into account for this position.

**Position salary range:

**For this position, the expected base pay range is kr53,360.00- kr80,040.00 for the advertised location. The offered base salary will be determined within this range based on relevant skills, experience, and expected role fulfilment within the stated pay range to ensure a fair and competitive offer. Where applicable, you may also be eligible for variable payment and a comprehensive benefits package.

**Our benefits package:

**For this position, employees who meet eligibility requirements have access to: employer‑paid pension (11% contribution), full insurance coverage (accident, life, critical illness, and health insurance); five weeks of paid holiday plus 10 additional paid days off per holiday year; a 3% holiday allowance; access to Ørsted Life & Fitness Vitality including fitness classes, physiotherapy, massage, and wellbeing programmes; a multimedia package (mobile phone, PC, internet); staff club membership with sport and cultural activities; and access to the company canteen (monthly lunch scheme or daily tickets).

**Pre-employment background check:

**Certain positions may require a background check as part of the hiring process. If applicable, you will be informed during the recruitment process. Background checks are conducted by an external provider in accordance with local legal requirements.

Imagine a future with Ørsted

Join a global leader in renewable energy

Ørsted is a global leader in offshore wind and is one of the largest renewable energy companies in the world. With us, you’ll play your part in creating a world that runs entirely on green energy. As a leading green energy company, we leverage the curiosity and passion of our people to innovate and develop new technologies or bring existing technologies to scale, collaborating with governments, suppliers, and our industry partners to make renewable energy solutions a reality. At Ørsted, we work together with openness and respect and seek fresh perspectives to solve any task at hand: big or small.

**About Ørsted

**

• We provide countries, companies, and communities with sustainable, reliable, and cost-competitive energy solutions, including offshore and onshore wind, solar PV, and energy storage.

• Our vision is to create a world that runs entirely on green energy.

• We built the world’s first offshore wind farm, Vindeby in Denmark, in 1991, and completed the world’s largest, Hornsea 2 in the UK, in 2022.

• We were founded in Denmark in 2006 and now have approximately 8,000 employees, working in 15 countries and counting.

An inclusive team

At Ørsted, we strive to be an inclusive workplace where you’re respected for who you are, valued for the unique perspectives you bring, and rewarded fairly for what you achieve. We want all employees to have the same opportunities for impact and growth, no matter their age, race, ethnicity, place of birth, gender, sexual orientation, or disability.

Job Description

At Netcompany, we are looking for recent graduates with a bachelor’s degree who want a challenging, social and developing start to their career as an Associate Consultant. Are you excited by the opportunity to work on complex IT solutions that make a real impact, while combining hands-on development with project delivery and close client interaction?

The Associate Consultant role exists across both Consulting and Application Services. The main difference lies in how you work with clients and solutions, and which setup fits your interests best. Either a more project-oriented environment (Consulting) or a more long-term, team- and solution-driven setup (Application Services).

Responsibilities & technologies

As an Associate Consultant at Netcompany, you will contribute to translating customer needs into the right technical solutions. Depending on the project and customer, you may become part of either our Application Services or Consulting business area. In both areas, you will work closely with exciting customers and colleagues to develop and deliver high-quality IT solutions. Your work will span different projects, technologies, and domains, giving you the opportunity to continuously expand your knowledge and expertise. We work with a wide range of technologies and platforms, such as .NET, C#, Java, React, Angular, Salesforce, Microsoft, Oracle, Adobe and more.

As an Associate Consultant, you will contribute to all aspects of system development with focus on technical tasks. Your tasks and responsibilities will vary from project to project and evolve over time, but your responsibilities will typically include:

• Customer dialogue and requirements clarification.

• Development of frontend and backend features for customer solutions.

• Setup and development of frameworks, integrations, and extensions for standard platforms.

• Automation of business processes through, for example, batch jobs.

• Development of tools and scripts for data migration and other technical solutions.

About you

We expect you to hold a bachelor's degree or diploma in engineering, computer science, software, IT, or a similar field. To succeed in this role, you:

• Are newly graduated or have a couple of years of experience. Most importantly, you are passionate about taking your IT career to the next level.

• Possess strong IT technical skills within object-oriented programming.

• Have fundamental knowledge of software development and are motivated to develop your competencies.

• Think analytically, show initiative, and work in a structured way.

• Full professional proficiency in Danish and English (written and spoken) is a must.

Continue developing with us

At Netcompany, we focus on your personal and professional development.

When you join us, you will be assigned a personal mentor who will guide you through your development and help you achieve your goals. The close relationship with an experienced colleague helps ensure the well-being of each employee and provides you with concrete insights into the many different career opportunities as you build your experience.

Additionally, you will be enrolled in our internal training programme, Netcompany Academy, where you are offered courses and seminars on everything from technologies to customer management. All courses are taught by experienced Netcompany colleagues, ensuring that all content is highly relevant and builds upon your professional skills, preparing you for various tasks and continuously improving your expertise throughout your career with us.

Join an inclusive community

At Netcompany, we highly prioritise an inclusive community. We actively promote an open and welcoming work culture based on collaboration and mutual trust, where there is always an opportunity for sparring.

As part of our culture and values, all employees, regardless of background, identity, and experience, are met with understanding and respect and given equal opportunities for development and well-being.

As we are an international company with offices in many countries, you will have the opportunity to learn and collaborate internationally with colleagues from across the world. We offer a shared environment where we engage with each other across departments and projects. Additionally, we have a wide range of social and professional events that provide you with the best opportunities to expand and build a network early in your career.

Send us your application

Upload your resume and a motivational letter to our recruitment system via the link. If you have unanswered questions, feel free to write to hr.dk@netcompany.com.

All qualified candidates are encouraged to apply regardless of gender, gender expression, sexuality, disability, age, religion and belief, political views, nationality, ethnicity, or social background.

We are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse environment. Our recruitment processes are based on individual merit. If you require any reasonable adjustments or additional support during the interview process, please email our recruiters at reasonableadjustments@netcompany.com for assistance. #LI-SA1
